text: The Abu Dhabi Sports Council says it was established in 2006 by Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, President of the United Arab Emirates, and is aligned to the emirate's leadership vision to develop sport and youth activities.
short: ADSC: established 2006 by Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed, aligned to the emirate's leadership
